title: SAR Conformance Vector Manifest
description: Machine-readable manifest for a SAR Protocol v1.0 conformance vector or vector group.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this vector. Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only.

description.description: What this vector proves or exercises.

kind.description: Vector kind: valid (must parse successfully), invalid (must be rejected), profile (profile-specific acceptance/rejection).

file.description: Relative path to the binary vector file from the manifest location. May be null for deferred/placeholder vectors.

profiles.description: SAR profiles this vector is relevant to. Use canonical profile names: static-archive, package, stream-package, backup, telemetry, live-media, cold-storage.

features.description: SAR feature tags this vector exercises (e.g. 'indexed', 'no-index', 'compression:zstd', 'crypto:aes-256-gcm', 'fec:xor'). Must be consistent with compression and crypto fields.

compression.description: Compression posture for this vector. Use false when the vector does not exercise compression. Use an object when it specifically exercises a compression algorithm.

oneOf.description: Not compressed, or compression is not the subject of this vector.

algorithm.description: Compression algorithm name: store, deflate, zstd, unsupported, reserved, or the actual algorithm.

id.description: Compression algorithm ID as hex string, e.g. '0x00'.

crypto.description: Crypto posture for this vector. Use false when not encrypted. Use an object when the vector exercises encryption/authentication.

algorithm.description: Encryption algorithm name: aes-256-gcm, xchacha20-poly1305, unsupported, reserved, tls-exporter, or the actual algorithm.

id.description: Encryption algorithm ID as hex string, e.g. '0x01'.

password.description: Test-only password for decryption. Intentionally included for public conformance testing. Never use real secrets here.

kms.description: KMS parameters for decryption. Intentionally included for public conformance testing.

requires_key_provider.description: When true, full validation requires explicit test key/password material from the manifest or validator context.

entries.description: Expected logical entries in the archive after all transforms (decrypt, decompress, patch, sparse reconstruction). Allows auditors to verify vector intent without reverse-engineering binary fixtures.

name.description: Entry name/path as stored in the archive.

payload_utf8.description: Logical payload as a UTF-8 string. Use for short textual payloads (size <= 60). Null for binary or large payloads.

payload_hex.description: Logical payload as a lowercase hex string. Use for binary payloads (size <= 60). Null for large or text payloads.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the logical payload. Required for all file entries.

payload_generation.description: Deterministic payload generation descriptor for large/generated payloads (size > 60 or logical_size > 60).

byte_hex.description: Single byte as hex for repeated_byte strategy.

pattern_hex.description: Pattern bytes as hex for repeated_pattern strategy.

path.description: Relative path to fixture file for external_fixture strategy.

symlink_target.description: Symlink target path. Required for symlink entries.

permissions.description: Unix permissions bits as an octal string with a leading zero, e.g. '0644', '0755', or '04755'.

extents.description: Sparse extents for sparse file entries.

base_files.description: Base files required for delta vector reconstruction. Includes the original content before patching.

path.description: Relative path to the base file from the manifest location.

payload_utf8.description: Base file content as UTF-8 string (for small textual content).

payload_hex.description: Base file content as hex string (for small binary content).

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the base file content.

payload_generation.description: Deterministic payload generation descriptor for large base files.

valid.description: Whether the vector is expected to parse and validate successfully.

status.description: Expected stable SAR status identifier. This is the authoritative machine-readable validation oracle. Use SAR_OK for success, or the relevant SAR_ERR_* identifier for failures.

error.description: Optional advisory human-readable debugging text. `expected.status` is authoritative; validators must not require exact `expected.error` string matching.

profile_expectations.description: Per-profile acceptance or rejection expectations. Values: 'accept', 'reject', 'skip'. Absent key means this profile is not addressed by this vector.

limits.description: ResourceLimits overrides to use when validating this vector. Keys are limit field names; values are integers.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about this vector: known gaps, deferral reasons, generation notes, crypto test-secret declarations.

deferred.description: When true, the binary vector file has not yet been generated. The manifest documents intended behavior; see notes for deferral reason.

generated_by.description: How the binary file was generated: 'rust-generator' (crates/sar-archive/examples/generate_vectors.rs), 'hand-crafted', or a description.
